# Function formulas --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
fun_formulas <- function(pathogen = "rota", data = "all", 
                         doses = "d1", model_nm = "csi", varname = "", varname2 = "",
                         others = "", multi = NULL, cens = TRUE) {
  
  # Covariates always included
  covars_mod <- c("1", "sex", "age", 
                  "(1|study)", "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)", others)
  
  # Adding seasonal covariates 
  if(model_nm == "base") {
    covars_mod <- covars_mod
    # Seasonal splines
  } else if(model_nm == "cc") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "s(vac_week_v1, bs = 'cc')")
  } else if(model_nm == "cci") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, glue("s(vac_week_v1, {varname}, bs = 'fs', xt = list(bs = 'cc'))"))
    # Cosine model 
  } else if(model_nm == "cs") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "cos(pi_vac_week_v1)", "sin(pi_vac_week_v1)")
  } else if(model_nm == "csni") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "cos(pi_vac_week_v1)", "sin(pi_vac_week_v1)", glue("{varname}"))
  } else if(model_nm == "csi") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, 
                    glue("{varname} * cos(pi_vac_week_v1)"), 
                    glue("{varname} * sin(pi_vac_week_v1)"))
    # Double model 
  } else if(model_nm == "cs2i") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, 
                    glue("{varname} * cos(pi_vac_week_v1)"), 
                    glue("{varname} * sin(pi_vac_week_v1)"),
                    glue("{varname2} * cos(pi_vac_week_v1)"), 
                    glue("{varname2} * sin(pi_vac_week_v1)"))
  } else if(model_nm == "cs2ni") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, 
                    "cos(pi_vac_week_v1)", "sin(pi_vac_week_v1)", 
                    glue("{varname}"), glue("{varname2}"))
  }
  
  # Adding time to vaccination covariates 
  if(doses == "d1") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "time_vl_s1") 
  } else if(doses == "d2") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "time_v1_v2", "time_vl_s1")
  } else if(doses == "d3") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_vl_s1")
  } else if(doses == "d4") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_v3_v4", "time_vl_s1")
  } else if(doses == "d5") {
    covars_mod <- c(covars_mod, "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "time_v3_v4", "time_v4_v5", "time_vl_s1")
  }
  
  if(doses == "d1") {
    doses_nm <- "v1" 
  } else {
    doses_nm <- "vl"
  }
  
  # Formula
  form_mod <- list(reformulate(termlabels = covars_mod, 
                               response = "imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ", intercept = T))
  
  if (length(multi != 0)) {
    if(cens == TRUE) { 
      form_mod <- list(reformulate(termlabels = covars_mod,
                                response = glue("imm_val_s1_{multi} | cens(censored_{multi})"), intercept = T))
    } else if (cens == FALSE) {
    form_mod <- list(reformulate(termlabels = covars_mod, 
                                 response = glue("imm_val_s1_{multi}"), intercept = T))
    }
  }
  
  if (model_nm %in% c("base", "cs", "cc")) {
    names(form_mod) = glue("bm{doses_nm}_{data}_{pathogen}_{model_nm}") 
  } else if (model_nm %in% c("cs2ni", "cs2i")) {
    names(form_mod) = glue("bm{doses_nm}_{data}_{pathogen}_{model_nm}_{varname}_{varname2}") 
  } else if (model_nm %in% c("cci", "csni", "csi")) {
    names(form_mod) = glue("bm{doses_nm}_{data}_{pathogen}_{model_nm}_{varname}") 
  }
  return(form_mod)
}
```

  # For s08 data

                                doses = doses, model_nm = "base", others = others))

# Read in cluster variable names
```{r}
cluster_varnames <- c("reg_6a", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2b")
cluster_varnames2 <- expand.grid(kgc = c("kgc_1", "kgc_2", "kgc_3"),
                                 reg = str_subset(cluster_varnames, "reg"))
```

# For ONLY CHECKING CONVERGENCE 
```{r}
fun_formulas_perpathogen <- function(pathogen = "rota", doses = "d3", others = "") {

  # For s08_kgc_3 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc3 <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(cluster_varnames2[[1]])) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc3 <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc3, fun_formulas(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "cs2i", others = others,
                                  varname = cluster_varnames2[i,1], varname2 = cluster_varnames2[i,2]))
  }
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc3) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc3),"_dfkgc3")

  # For s08_kgc_2 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc2 <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2"))[[1]])) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc2 <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc2, fun_formulas(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "cs2i", others = others,
                                  varname = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2"))[i,1], 
                                  varname2 = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2"))[i,2]))
  }
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc2) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc2),"_dfkgc2")
  
  # For s08_kgc_1 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc1 <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1"))[[1]])) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc1 <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc1, fun_formulas(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "cs2i", others = others,
                                  varname = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1"))[i,1], 
                                  varname2 = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1"))[i,2]))
  }
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc1) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc1),"_dfkgc1")
  
  l_formula <- add_new_expression(l_formula_s08_dfkgc3, l_formula_s08_dfkgc2, omit_exp = T)
  l_formula <- add_new_expression(l_formula, l_formula_s08_dfkgc1, omit_exp = T)
  
  saveRDS(l_formula, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula)
}
```

```{r}
fun_formulas_perpathogen <- function(pathogen = "rota", doses = "d3", others = "",
                                     dfkgc = "3") {

  # For s08_kgc_3 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- list()
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                doses = doses, model_nm = "base", others = others))
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                doses = doses, model_nm = "cs", others = others))
  for (i in cluster_varnames) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "csni", others = others, 
                                  varname = i))
  }
  for (i in cluster_varnames) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "csi", others = others, 
                                  varname = i))
  }
  
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc), "_dfkgc", dfkgc)

  saveRDS(l_formula_s08_dfkgc, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula_s08_dfkgc)
}
```

# MVN MODELS =======================================================================================

```{r}
fun_formulas_multipathogen <- function(pathogen = "multi_men", doses = "d3", model_nm = "base", 
                                       data = "s08", varname = "", varname2 = "",
                                       others = "", cens = F) {
  
  multi_pat <- list(multi_men = c("anti_menc", "anti_mena"),
                    multi_pn = c("anti_pn_04", "anti_pn_06b", "anti_pn_09v", "anti_pn_18c", "anti_pn_23f"),
                    multi_polio = c("anti_polio_1", "anti_polio_2", "anti_polio_3"),
                    multi_ipv = c("anti_polio_1", "anti_polio_2", "anti_polio_3"),
                    multi_opv = c("anti_polio_1", "anti_polio_2", "anti_polio_3"),
                    multi_pertu = c("anti_pertu_pt", "anti_pertu_prn", "anti_pertu_fha"),
                    multi_mmrv = c("anti_measles", "anti_mumps", "anti_rubella", "anti_varicella"),
                    multi_mmr = c("anti_measles", "anti_mumps", "anti_rubella"),
                    multi_dtp = c("anti_dipht", "anti_tetan", "anti_pertu_pt"),
                    multi_hibmen = c("anti_hib", "anti_menc"))[[pathogen]]
  
  bf_formula <- list()
  for (i in multi_pat) {
    bf_formula <- add_new_expression(bf_formula,
        fun_formulas(pathogen = glue("{pathogen}_{i}"), data = data, 
                 doses = doses, model_nm = model_nm, varname = varname, varname2 = varname2,
                 others = others, multi = i, cens = cens))
  }
  
  if(cens == FALSE) {
    name_cens = "gauss"
    if(length(multi_pat) == 2) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]) + gaussian(link = "log"))
    } else if(length(multi_pat) == 3) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]) + bf(bf_formula[[3]]) + 
      gaussian(link = "log"))
    } else if(length(multi_pat) == 4) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]) + bf(bf_formula[[3]]) + 
      bf(bf_formula[[4]]) + gaussian(link = "log"))
    } else if(length(multi_pat) == 5) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]) + bf(bf_formula[[3]]) + 
      bf(bf_formula[[4]]) + bf(bf_formula[[5]]) + gaussian(link = "log"))
    }
  }
  
  if(cens == TRUE) {
    name_cens = "gamma"
    if(length(multi_pat) == 2) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]))
    } else if(length(multi_pat) == 3) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]) + bf(bf_formula[[3]]))
    } else if(length(multi_pat) == 4) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]) + bf(bf_formula[[3]]) + 
      bf(bf_formula[[4]]))
    } else if(length(multi_pat) == 5) {
    mbf_formula = list(bf(bf_formula[[1]]) + bf(bf_formula[[2]]) + bf(bf_formula[[3]]) + 
      bf(bf_formula[[4]]) + bf(bf_formula[[5]]))
    }
  }
  
  name_formula <- str_replace(str_remove(names(bf_formula), multi_pat), "__", "_")[[1]]
  
  names(mbf_formula) <- glue("{name_formula}_{name_cens}")
  return(mbf_formula)
}
```

# MVN COMPARISON MODELS ============================================================================
 
# Read in cluster variable names
```{r}
cluster_varnames <- c("reg_6a", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2b")
cluster_varnames2 <- expand.grid(kgc = c("kgc_1", "kgc_2", "kgc_3"),
                                 reg = str_subset(cluster_varnames, "reg"))
```

# For ONLY CHECKING CONVERGENCE 
```{r}
fun_formulas_multipathogen_list <- function(pathogen = "multi_men", doses = "d3", others = "") {

  # For s08_kgc_3 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc3 <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(cluster_varnames2[[1]])) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc3 <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc3, fun_formulas_multipathogen(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "cs2i", others = others, cens = F,
                                  varname = cluster_varnames2[i,1], varname2 = cluster_varnames2[i,2]))
  }
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc3) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc3),"_dfkgc3")

  # For s08_kgc_2 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc2 <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2"))[[1]])) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc2 <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc2, fun_formulas_multipathogen(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "cs2i", others = others, cens = F,
                                  varname = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2"))[i,1], 
                                  varname2 = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2"))[i,2]))
  }
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc2) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc2),"_dfkgc2")
  
  # For s08_kgc_1 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc1 <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1"))[[1]])) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc1 <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc1, fun_formulas_multipathogen(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "cs2i", others = others, cens = F,
                                  varname = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1"))[i,1], 
                                  varname2 = filter(cluster_varnames2, kgc %in% c("kgc_1"))[i,2]))
  }
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc1) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc1),"_dfkgc1")
  
  l_formula <- add_new_expression(l_formula_s08_dfkgc3, l_formula_s08_dfkgc2, omit_exp = T)
  l_formula <- add_new_expression(l_formula, l_formula_s08_dfkgc1, omit_exp = T)
  
  saveRDS(l_formula, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula)
}
```

# ONCE CONVERGENCE IS CHECKED
```{r}
fun_formulas_multipathogen_list <- function(pathogen = "multi_men", doses = "d3", others = "",
                                     dfkgc = "3") {
  
  # For s08 data 
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- list()
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas_multipathogen(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                doses = doses, model_nm = "base", others = others))
  
  l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas_multipathogen(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                doses = doses, model_nm = "cs", others = others))
  
  for (i in cluster_varnames) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas_multipathogen(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08",
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "csni", others = others,
                                  varname = i))
  }
  for (i in cluster_varnames) {
    l_formula_s08_dfkgc <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula_s08_dfkgc, fun_formulas_multipathogen(pathogen = pathogen, data = "s08", 
                                  doses = doses, model_nm = "csi", others = others, 
                                  varname = i))
  }
  
  names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc) = paste0(names(l_formula_s08_dfkgc), "_dfkgc", dfkgc)
  l_formula <- l_formula_s08_dfkgc
  
  saveRDS(l_formula, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula)
}
```
